subject.title: [Feishu] "This reply completed without visible content" fallback incorrectly triggered for long/markdown-heavy replies (regression from #87896)

question: Is the issue's session-level telemetry enough to promote a repair now, or should maintainers require a live Feishu/trajectory reproduction that shows where the long markdown final disappears before coding?
rationale: The user-visible failure is plausible and high impact, but source inspection does not yet prove whether the failing layer is final extraction, Feishu card/text delivery, streaming-card close, or accounting; choosing the wrong layer could suppress a valid fallback or create another silent-drop path.

options.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
options.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction showing assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

options.title: Promote guarded source investigation
options.body: Allow a repair worker to add a focused regression harness only if it first reproduces the zero-final long-markdown path without broadly changing fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Require live or trajectory proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Feishu transcript/log or run a live reproduction showing assistant final text, delivery attempts, failed counts, and fallback trigger before promoting a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant history shows concentrated follow-up work on the Feishu fallback edge cases and failed visible final handling in the merged fallback line.
